subject: Urgent help needed: Error - Exiftool not found ?

messages.author: 801722d43588a5ba
messages.subject: Urgent help needed: Error - Exiftool not found ?
parts:
Hi all,

I am new to camtrapR and was hoping some experienced users can help me out with the issue. I have followed all the steps to properly install exiftool and have also re-installed it many times but I keep getting the error that its not found. I am Windows 10 user. 

> library(camtrapR) 
> setwd("C:/Users/salon/Desktop")
> Sys.getenv("C:/Users/salon/Desktop/exiftool.exe")
[1] ""
> Sys.which("exiftool")
exiftool 
      "" 
> system("exiftool")
Warning message:
running command 'exiftool' had status 127 
> exiftool
Error: object 'exiftool' not found







> exiftool_dir <- "C:/Users/salon/Desktop/exiftool.exe"        
> exiftoolPath(exiftoolDir = exiftool_dir)
> Sys.which("exiftool") ## To check if system can find ExifTool
exiftool 
      "" 
> system("exiftool")
Warning message:
running command 'exiftool' had status 127 
> exiftool
Error: object 'exiftool' not found


-Saloni

messages.author: a9b015cd2c9c75be
messages.subject: Re: Urgent help needed: Error - Exiftool not found ?
parts:
Hi Saloni,

Could you please try copying ExifTool to "C:/Windows" folder. Also, rename 'exiftool(-r)' or 'exiftool.exe' to just be 'exiftool'. This usually does the trick for our work computers. 

If you run command:

system("exiftool")

it should find it (*touch wood*).

Best Wishes
